snippet.title: Templar Assault - Extermination Level Walkthrough
snippet.description:
Play Templar Assault for Free on Google Play - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tresebrothers.games.templars&hl=en

The last level of the Templar Assault tutorial can be very difficult -- Extermination.  It will require you to use all of your tactical training and strategies to complete.  This walk through shows one way of beating the level on Brutal difficulty, against all the odds and the waves of aliens.
